name: Ammonites
overview: The Ammonites were descendants of Ben-ammi, a son of Lot, and their territory was recognized as a possession given by God to the children of Lot, which Israel was commanded not to disturb or claim (Genesis 19:38; Deuteronomy 2:19, 37). Despite this, the Ammonites were excluded from entering the congregation of the LORD even to the tenth generation because of their hostile actions toward Israel, including hiring Balaam to curse the Israelites (Deuteronomy 23:3-4). Israel defeated the Ammonites and took possession of parts of their land, yet God's specific command to avoid disturbing their territory highlights His sovereign purposes in preserving distinct peoples and boundaries.
